chunks: Regarding the expiation of an oath: it is a mudd and a handful.

key_terms.حَفْنَةٌ: a handful added to the specified measure
key_terms.كَفَّارَةِ: expiation or compensation required for a violation
key_terms.مُدٌّ: a standard measure of food used in legal rulings

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation amount for a broken oath in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the kaffarah of an oath. It specifies the amount due as expiation in a concise measure: one mudd and a handful.
